BUILT FOR MULTI-PROVIDER TEAMS

A routing decision your team can inspect.

01

Constraints before scores

Models that violate risk, boundary, modality, context, cost, or latency requirements are rejected before ranking.

02

Visible tradeoffs

Choose balanced, quality, cost, or latency. Component scores show exactly why the winner moved.

03

Low-custody by default

The hosted service accepts routing metadata only. The optional customer-local harness makes provider calls in your environment with your provider account.

04

Receipts without bodies

Local runs produce correlation digests, events, route facts, and usage without placing task or output text in receipts.

LOCAL JOB MODE

Make a multi-step route legible before anyone runs it.

Plan-only timeline

A sanitized fictional local manifest routes each ordered step with caller-supplied catalog evidence and explicit policy. It does not infer a phase from task text, learn from transcripts, or use phase labels as scoring inputs.

External handoff is visible

Read steps can be marked eligible. Write-capable or side-effecting steps are labeled as external handoffs, not executed by Nymrel Agent.

Lifecycle stays local

Callers can retain a bounded digest-and-ordinal checkpoint chain. Nymrel Agent returns the next envelope; it stores nothing and runs no background job.

fictional-game-builder.plan.txt
Fictional 48-hour game builder · local plan only
1 research-scope    objective:quality   model:provider-b/fast             deps:none           read-only eligible
2 plan-slice        objective:balanced  model:provider-b/fast             deps:research-scope read-only eligible
3 build-prototype   objective:balanced  model:provider-b/fast             deps:plan-slice     EXTERNAL HANDOFF
4 review-build      objective:quality   model:provider-b/fast             deps:build-prototype read-only eligible
5 release-handoff   objective:quality   model:provider-a/reasoning-large  deps:review-build    EXTERNAL HANDOFF

Policy and caller-supplied evidence drive each selection. Phase labels do not affect scoring.

Download the sanitized fictional manifest · Download the deterministic summary

The hosted API remains metadata-only routing. Job Mode, Lifecycle, and MCP planning have no hosted endpoint, provider call, or customer-data persistence.

THE LOCAL-FIRST BOUNDARY

Useful now. Honest about what is next.

The public product routes; it does not execute model calls. The local harness executes read-only requests through configured adapters. Write-capable tools, hosted provider-key custody, billing, and autonomous side effects are outside this release.
